_what: Where the signed-in workspace keeps its saved records (sql-records.ts): one table, made by the workspace in the person's own database on its first write, reached through the SQL tool with the connection the person saved under `credential_name`.

retry._what: After a write the database refused or could not be reached, the next write waits first_ms, doubled after each further failure up to most_ms, and a written batch ends the wait. A refused write puts the old value back and a screen writes again, so without the wait one unreachable database became 1,278 tool runs in 20 s (Nov 20 2026).
